name: behavior_pair
prompt:
Two frames from the forward-facing camera of a car driving on a public road. The LEFT image was taken {dt_s} seconds BEFORE the RIGHT image.

Compare them: how far the scene has moved between the two frames tells you how fast the car is going, and how the road has swung tells you whether it is turning.

Describe what the car is doing in the RIGHT (later) frame.

Choose exactly one steering description:
- "going straight"
- "slightly steering to the left"
- "slightly steering to the right"
- "steering to the left"
- "steering to the right"

And exactly one speed description:
- "not moving"
- "driving slowly"
- "driving with normal speed"
- "driving fast"
- "driving very fast"

Respond as JSON: {"steer": "one of the steering descriptions", "speed": "one of the speed descriptions", "reason": "one short sentence"}
